description: This is an HTML source file that implements the user interface for a database visualization dashboard, including navigation, table rendering, and interactive features.
external_files: fetch API (implied, used for data retrieval via /api/... endpoints)

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and resets UI states.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles expansion for a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables within a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data from a selected table and renders it.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML table for given data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling objects, nulls, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Handles expanding truncated cell content to full view.
